picks.title: Financial risk management platform Pillar raises $20M seed in round led by a16z
picks.why_it_matters: A $20M seed led by a16z for fintech infrastructure signals strong investor appetite for B2B tools that democratize sophisticated financial capabilities for SMBs—a category with proven enterprise value creation.

picks.title: AI data center startup Fluidstack in talks for $1B round at $18B valuation months after hitting $7.5B, says report
picks.why_it_matters: The rapid 2.4x valuation jump validates AI infrastructure as the picks-and-shovels play of this cycle, suggesting early-stage opportunities in adjacent areas like cooling, power optimization, and data center tooling.

picks.title: OpenAI expands access to cyber AI as hacking risks grow
picks.why_it_matters: OpenAI opening access to advanced cyber-capable models creates immediate startup opportunities in AI-powered security tools, while the access controls hint at emerging compliance frameworks founders will need to navigate.
